messages:
maggie: Heads-up — customer 'AcmeSoft' reported they could list workspaces across a sibling org after a permissions change this morning. Seen it in SSO logs + customer screenshots. Can security take a quick look?

irene: Ugh. Any idea which RBAC change landed? I saw a refactor of role aliasing last week.

maggie: Deploys early today included the role-binding refactor (PR #4218). Posting the relevant logs: https://logs.redwood/ops/1901712 (redacted). Customer IDs: org-acme / org-acme-partner.

sanjeev: I pulled the role_binding printout from prod for the affected workspaces. Looks like a binding created with `resource_type: workspace` but `org_id` is missing (null) so the enforcement layer fell back to org-level resolution. Snippet: ```json
{"id":"rb-9932","role":"workspace.viewer","resource_type":"workspace","resource_id":"ws-77","org_id":null,"subject":{"type":"service_account","id":"sa-inference"}}```

irene: If org_id is null the middleware is supposed to enforce a stricter check. That logic changed during the refactor — possible regression where `resource_type == workspace` path doesn't set org_id from project metadata.

audit-bot: [automated] grant_event detected: grant_created actor=sa-inference resource=workspace/ws-77 scope=fallback_policy timestamp=1901712402

maggie: Also seeing KMS unwrap logs for service account: `kms:unwrap success key=projects/keys/k-prod-acme` — means the SA had access to the KMS key used for workspace secrets. Could be two contributing issues (rbac + kms policy).

ramon: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) disable role-aliasing feature-flag `role_aliasing_v2` to prevent new null-org bindings, 2) add temp ACL rule blocking `sa-inference` from listing sibling org workspaces, 3) rotate the KMS key for the affected workspace.

sanjeev: I'm prepping a hotfix to the RBAC middleware to explicitly populate `org_id` from resource metadata and to reject bindings with null org for workspace resources. Will open a quick rollback PR for the refactor too. ETA ~20m for a canary patch.

irene: I'll run a query to enumerate potentially affected bindings so we can bulk fix or revoke: ```sql
SELECT id, subject_id, resource_type, resource_id FROM role_bindings WHERE resource_type='workspace' AND org_id IS NULL;```

maggie: Also please add a check to the audit pipeline to raise a high-severity alert when `grant_created` events occur with `scope=fallback_policy` or `org_id=null`. Compliance needs a copy of the list for customer notification.

audit-bot: [automated] alert_created severity=high rule=grant-null-org count=12 window=1h

ramon: I'll file the incident ticket (INC-2026-042) and ping CS to draft an external notification. Compliance wants rotation proof before we message customers.

sanjeev: Hotfix merged to canary cluster. Patch adds org population + rejects null-org workspace bindings. Rolling canary now (canary nodes 2/2 healthy). Will promote after 15m smoke.

maggie: Good. After promote: rotate keys for ws-77, revoke any temp tokens, and run the `org_id IS NULL` script to remediate. Then postmortem + timeline.

irene: I'll own the remediation script and postmortem write-up. tagging @legal @compliance in the incident doc.

maggie: Thanks all. Please keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
